key_value_text.quote: Based on the comparison, we obtain a 95\% C.L. excluded region of $0.1<|\Delta m_{41}^2|<7$\,eV$^2$.
key_value_text.value: 95% C.L. excluded region of 0.1<|delta m41^2|<7 eV^2; best fit |delta m41^2| = 2.41 +- 0.03 eV^2, sin^2 2 theta14 = 0.08 +- 0.03 (p-value 8.2%)

name: Search for sterile neutrino oscillation using RENO and NEOS data

significance.value: 95% C.L. exclusion; allowed region at 68% C.L. with a p-value of 8.2%

summary.plain: RENO and NEOS, whose detectors sit 294 and 24 metres from the same reactor complex, compared their antineutrino spectra directly, largely cancelling reactor uncertainties. They excluded a wide range of sterile-neutrino mass splittings while finding a mild (8 per cent p-value) preference for one point.
summary.technical: Reactor-model-independent comparison of 2509 days of RENO near-detector data with 180 days of NEOS data (baselines 294 m and 24 m): 95 % CL exclusion of 0.1 < |delta m^2_41| < 7 eV^2 and a 68 % CL allowed region at |delta m^2_41| = 2.41 +- 0.03 eV^2, sin^2(2 theta_14) = 0.08 +- 0.03 (p = 8.2 %).

title: Search for sterile neutrino oscillation using RENO and NEOS data
why_it_matters: A nearly flux-model-independent short-baseline sterile-neutrino search using two detectors at one commercial reactor complex.
